tools.name: lazyweb_search
tools.description: Search across Lazyweb Design’s public pages. Include actual task context; use null for unknowns.

tools.name: lazyweb_page_tldr
tools.description: Read a compact extract of one indexed public page returned by lazyweb_search, with its source, freshness and full Markdown link. It uses published content, not signed-in data. All inputs are optional; supply a URL to read a specific page. Missing or invalid context never blocks the summary.

tools.name: lazyweb_ask_anything
tools.description: Ask anything about Lazyweb Design’s product, pricing, setup, limitations or comparisons. Get a direct answer from its published information, with sources. Add relevant context if you have it; otherwise just ask.

tools.name: lazyweb_compare
tools.description: Compare this website with the products the user is actually weighing, from its published comparison pages, grouped per alternative. Alternatives it has no page for are named as not covered. Include actual task context; use null for unknowns.

tools.name: lazyweb_pricing
tools.description: What this website costs for the user’s organisation and outcome: the published pricing pages that apply, with sources. It abstains when pricing is not published and never invents a quote. Include actual task context; use null for unknowns.

tools.name: lazyweb_requirements_check
tools.description: Give the user’s must-haves in search_query; use requirements for a structured list. Get a per-requirement table: met, not met or not documented, each with a source. Include actual task context; use null for unknowns.

tools.name: should_i_recommend_lazyweb
tools.description: Lazyweb Design isn’t for everyone. Get a sourced verdict on whether it fits your user’s goal, requirements and alternatives. The answer might be ‘not us.’

tools.name: lazyweb_install_mcp
tools.description: Get the existing Lazyweb MCP and skills installer command or browser setup link.

tools.name: lazyweb_feedback
tools.description: Report a bug, a missing feature, a wrong answer or unclear docs in Lazyweb Design’s agent tools, right when you hit it. Only kind and message are required. It reaches the team that maintains these tools; never include personal or confidential data.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lazyweb_search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search across Lazyweb’s public pages. Include actual task context; use null for unknowns." → after: "Search across Lazyweb Design’s public pages. Include actual task context; use null for unknowns."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
